title: Fault codes and cleared faults
summary: This topic centers on detected fault codes, stored faults, and reports of faults being cleared, with feedback dominated by service or diagnostic issue descriptions rather than stable resolution details.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention that no relevant fault codes were found or that dealers could not detect a fault.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe vehicles arriving with faults, stored or specific fault codes, and repairs or resets that cleared faults without broader context showing the issue was fully resolved.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews briefly state that an error or notification cleared by itself, but they do not provide enough context to judge whether this reflects a good or bad outcome.

limitations: The sample fragments are heavily diagnostic and service-note oriented, so customer impact and final repair outcomes are often unclear.
At least one negative example appears semantically inconsistent with its assigned sentiment, which limits precise interpretation of that fragment.
Some fragments are too brief or truncated to determine whether a cleared fault meant a resolved issue or only a temporary reset.
